Product_Name: Conair Double Ceramic Hair Dryer | Blow Dryer with Ionic Conditioning | Includes Concentrator
Ai_text: Customers like the drying time, weight and value of the hair dryer. For example, they mention it does a good job at drying their hair evenly, it's lightweight and good value for money. Some like the appearance. That said, some complain about the durability and cord length. Opinions are mixed on quality and temperature.
Descrizione:
The Conair 1875 Watt Double Ceramic Dryer features double ceramic technology, plus frizz-fighting conditioning ions for less damage and more shine. Double ceramic technology in this hair dryer provides infrared and uniform heat for fast drying and less damage. Conditioning ions in this blow dryer help to fight frizz and bring out your hair’s natural shine. This dryer for hair dries your hair fast with 1875 watts of power. A cool shot button locks hair styles in place. Rocker switches provided for easy handling when drying hair. 3 heat/2 speed dryer settings provide custom settings for different hair types. A removable filter prevents lint buildup, extending the blow dryer’s motor life. Concentrator included for focused airflow to make hair smooth and sleek.
The Conair 1875 Watt Double Ceramic Hair Dryer comes in beauty white and rose gold finish, right on trend!
